coachView.name: MultiCheckbox
coachView.layout:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><ns2:layout xmlns:ns2="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/CoachDesignerNG" xmlns:ns3="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/coachview"><ns2:layoutItem xsi:type="ns2:CustomHTML" version="8550" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>75721be7-a219-4277-a5df-3c08f0692ff2</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>CustomHTML1</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>35b039e8-14d6-455b-a61b-2d20a22c7837</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.contentType</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>TEXT</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>21ca5d82-2889-4084-90fe-4abd11f75587</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.textContent</ns2:optionName><ns2:value><div class="multicheckbox-container" role="group" aria-labelledby="multicheckbox-label">
  <div class="multicheckbox-label-wrapper">
    <label id="multicheckbox-label" class="multicheckbox-label"></label>
  </div>
  <div class="multicheckbox-select-all-wrapper">
    <label class="multicheckbox-option multicheckbox-select-all-option">
      <input type="checkbox" class="multicheckbox-input multicheckbox-select-all-input" id="multicheckbox-select-all">
      <span class="multicheckbox-checkbox" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M6.5 11.7L3.3 8.5l.7-.7 2.5 2.5 5.2-5.2.7.7z"/></svg>
      </span>
      <span class="multicheckbox-label-text multicheckbox-select-all-text">Select All</span>
    </label>
  </div>
  <div class="multicheckbox-options" role="list">
    <!-- Checkbox options will be dynamically generated -->
  </div>
  <div class="multicheckbox-helper-text"></div>
</div></ns2:value></ns2:configData></ns2:layoutItem></ns2:layout>
coachView.description: Multi-checkbox widget for selecting multiple values with direct checkbox display for IBM Business Automation Workflow

configOption.description: Array of available options with value and name properties
